headlines.description: Argentina beat Venezuela 3-0 on Thursday night as Lionel Messi scored two goals in his final competitive home match in front of his country's fans in Buenos Aires.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messi nets 2 in last home game as Argentina win

headlines.description: Chelsea forward Estêvão scored his first goal for Brazil in a 3-0 win over Chile in South American World Cup qualifying.
headlines.shortLinkText: Paqueta, Guimaraes, Estêvão on target in Brazil win

headlines.description: Miguel Terceros scored from a penalty in the first half and Bolivia downed Brazil 1-0 on Tuesday in South American qualifying which combined with Colombia's win over Venezuela helped the Bolivians advance to the playoff tournament for the 2026 World Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bolivia stun Brazil to secure WC playoff spot
